Sometimes, the greatest miracles come in the smallest packages.
CJ7 follows Dicky, a poor construction worker who struggles to give his young son a better life. One day, he discovers a mysterious alien toy that turns out to be a magical creature with extraordinary powers. As the bond between the family and their unexpected friend grows stronger, they learn valuable lessons about love, sacrifice, hope, and the true meaning of happiness.
Heartwarming, funny, and filled with imagination, CJ7 is a touching family film that reminds us that love is the greatest superpower of all.
